source.name: Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2025-26 — Horticulture, sourced from Horticulture Area Production Information System (HAPIS), Government of India

notes: Category totals are Maharashtra values reported in the Economic Survey of Maharashtra 2025-26 and sourced from HAPIS, Government of India.

The survey explicitly identifies the major fruit and vegetable crops and their area for 2024-25; crop-level production for those rows is not reproduced here unless verified from the underlying HAPIS crop table.
Spice crop names are catalogued separately from the HAPIS spice universe; Maharashtra crop-level values will be added only after the state-row extraction is verified.
No AI-estimated crop production values are inserted.
